notes.title: Update From Corporate
notes.content:
[p]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]The manual save button has been removed, the game now auto-saves much more often[/p][/*][*][p]Reset all progress button has been added to the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]New run button in the options panel has been changed to read abandon run, same functionality[/p][/*][*][p]The start run button in the main menu has been changed to continue, same functionality[/p][/*][*][p]Updates to the environment art have been made[/p][/*][*][p]Minor updates to the particle effects have been made[/p][/*][/list][p]BUG FIXES[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]The corruption eye animation no longer blocks certain click events, this was blocking hovering over the deck count for the tooltip and the back button on the music options at high corruption[/p][/*][*][p]Corruption icon that slides across the bar had a similar problem[/p][/*][*][p]Flickering in the ground after playing the tutorial has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Several small fixes to the tutorial, liquidation should always reactivate after the fight despite triggering the tutorial text or not, triggering double tooltips causing it to lock up is no longer possible, and all the tutorial information should clear more cleanly after completing[/p][/*][*][p]Music options have been cleaned up, cd art was getting scrambled in some cases
[/p][/*][/list][p]SPECIFIC CARD CHANGES[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Steel Demon changed to grant all Gorps 60 power and 30 armor, instead of just one[/p][/*][*][p]High Visibility nerfed, reduces corporate card cost by 400, down from 500[/p][/*][*][p]Luxury Fork now pulls a rare from both sets of cards instead of only set 1[/p][/*][*][p]Salesman Ale fixed to always create a demon if there is room in hand[/p][/*][*][p]Inflated Ego now correctly only targets Agents[/p][/*][*][p]Memory Wipe now correctly only targets Agents[/p][/*][*][p]Keen Awareness hitbox fixed to only target a single Cat[/p][/*][*][p]Bio Accelerant hitbox fixed to only target a single Alien[/p][/*][*][p]Virtual Blindfold hitbox fixed to only target a single Character[/p][/*][*][p]Crawl for Favor hitbox fixed to only target a single Agent[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Update From Corporate
notes.content: [p][b]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b][/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Many enemies have been rigged and now have first draft basic animations in place[/p][/*][*][p]Some enemy models have been replaced with entirely new ones[/p][/*][*][p]Environment assets updated, there are a few battlefield variations now[/p][/*][*][p]New music has been added to the battle music playlist[/p][/*][/list][p][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Michael Fritz now reduces salary on attack in all situations[/p][/*][*][p]Various other card-specific bugs fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Modifier enemy names should read correctly now in all cases[/p][/*][*][p]Battle music option panel should always automatically close after a fight now[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Booster Set #2
notes.content: [p]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]BOOSTER SET #2 INTRODUCES 100 NEW CARDS[/p][/*][*][p]THESE PACKS ARE AVAILABLE FROM THE START OF THE GAME FOR 20 PACK TICKETS[/p][/*][*][p]ALL BOSSES HAVE BEEN REBALANCED, GENERALLY LOWERED IN POWER AND HP ACROSS THE BOARD[/p][/*][*][p]ROBOT BOSS MODEL ADJUSTED[/p][/*][*][p]NEW ICONS FOR STEALTH, VOID, AND CORPORATE DAMAGE[/p][/*][*][p]A NEW BUDGET CHEAT CODE FOR TESTING PURPOSES[/p][/*][*][p]NEW BATTLE MUSIC PLAYER ADDED, NEXT TO THE OPTION BUTTON YOU CAN NOW FLIP THROUGH A FEW TRACKS, MORE TO COME[/p][/*][*][p]ANOTHER NEW BUTTON NEXT TO OPTIONS IS A BATTLE CAMERA SWAP BUTTON, YOU CAN STILL USE TAB TO SWAP BETWEEN BATTLE CAMERAS[/p][/*][*][p]COPORATE CARDS NOW HAVE A TOOLTIP THAT COMMUNICATES THAT THEY ARE IN FACT, CORPORATE CARDS[/p][/*][*][p]CARDS THAT GENERATE A RANDOM CHARACTER OF X TYPE NOW PULL FROM BOTH SETS OF AVAILABLE CHARACTER CARDS[/p][/*][*][p]CARD COST HAS BEEN REMOVED FROM THE CUSTOM GAME MODIFIER LIST[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]SPECIFIC CARD CHANGES[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]TWIN BUDGET NOW INCREASES CORRUPTION BY 50[/p][/*][*][p]DIVISION CUTS NOW INCREASES CORRUPTION BY 30[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]BUGS[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]CORRUPTION BAR HOVER TOOLTIP TEXT UPDATED[/p][/*][*][p]SECOND PHASE OF MALCOLM KESSLER BOSS TRIGGER FOR ENEMY TOOLTIP ADJUSTED[/p][/*][*][p]MAP NODES SHOULD NOW SAVE AND RELOAD PROPERLY, THERE WERE SOME CASES OF DISSAPPEARING NODES ON RELOAD BEFORE THIS UPDATE[/p][/*][*][p]MUSIC BUG CAUSING THE PLAYLIST TO RESTART ON ENEMY DEATH FIXED[/p][/*][*][p]TOOLTIP HOVER BUGS SMOOTHED OUT[/p][/*][*][p]AUTO NAVIGATION FOR BUTTONS TURNED OFF[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Hotfix: Difficulty Modifier
notes.content: [p]Couple quick changes to the new damage difficulty scaling[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]An enemy damage modifier value has been added in the custom game settings, defaulting at 5, you can turn it off entirely by setting it to 0  [/p][/*][*][p]Bug fix, the tooltip display value was showing double the actual damage increase value, should always display correctly now[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Large Update from Corporate 8/24/2025
notes.content: [p]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Peter Lurtex, the third boss fight, is now accessible at level 8[/p][/*][*][p]Loop Machine added as a new mob that heals when you play corporate cards[/p][/*][*][p]Loss condition change, the run only ends if all field slots have been destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]All enemy power ranges including bosses now scale up with corruption, increasing the difficulty of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies that have 0 power do not get scaled up at all by corruption and still deal 0 damage regardless of corruption level[/p][/*][*][p]Drawing from an empty deck now destroys a random field slot. Empty field slots are not given priority over occupied field slots like with most enemy attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Deck count UI has been slightly separated visually from your salary/budget[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Starting pack tickets reduced to 20, down from 30, other means of acquiring cards are in the works for future updates[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]SPECIFIC CARD CHANGES[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Chaos Demon now creates a Gorp in your hand instead of a meteor[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Snowball changed to create a meteor in hand if there is room on death instead of returning to hand[/p][/*][*][p]Protection Angel now reads "The enemy cannot do anything until after your next turn"[/p][/*][*][p]Protection Angel is now connected to the enemy when played, if that enemy dies the next one will not be prevented from action even if it is still the same turn you played the Angel[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]BUGS[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Pack tickets should no longer reset to 30 on save and reload[/p][/*][*][p]Damon's triple attack should no longer be able to trigger on death effects more than once[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the rotation of the main map would sometimes `initialize regardless of mouse click[/p][/*][*][p]Protection Angel no longer grants double salary gains after playing[/p][/*][*][p]Pollinator should always generate the Angel Egg now[/p][/*][*][p]Pollinator is now recognized as being of the ALIEN tribe/character type and should trigger other cards accordingly[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update From Corporate 8/17/2025
notes.content: [p]GENERAL CHANGES[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]All enemies now grow stronger as you progress through the game, including bosses. This is a direct difficulty increase to the entire game[/p][/*][*][p]There is a new modifier for tickets you start a run with[/p][/*][*][p]New runs now start with a default of 30 tickets up from 10[/p][/*][*][p]Small transition cutscenes between phase 1 and 2 of boss fights replaced for now[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]CARD SPECIFIC CHANGES[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Instructor Garth: On play damage has been increased from 70 to 120[/p][/*][*][p]Alice Gray: On play damage for each Agent in play increased from 20 to 40[/p][/*][*][p]Factory Drone: Cost reduced from 1000 to 500 power reduced from 50 to 20[/p][/*][*][p]Hitman:[/p][p]Power and HP  both reduced from 50 to 30[/p][p]Cost increased to 1400 up from 1250[/p][p]Salary gain reduced from +150 to +100[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]BUG FIXES[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]The liquidate button should no longer be visible until it's usable in the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Effects that create a card in your hand if there is room, should no longer be able to increase your hand size above the cap of 5[/p][/*][*][p]The card Upgrade should no longer grant double the power bonus[/p][/*][*][p]SFX fixed on custom game options and start menu[/p][/*][*][p]XP bar tooltip glitch fixed[/p][/*][*][p]The cheat that deals damage to your own characters should no longer be able to deal multiple instances of damage at a time, resulting in less bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Office Grunt has been removed from the modifier list so that there is always at least one viable mob[/p][/*][*][p]Ticket display in the collection/deckbuilding screen should now always accurately show how many tickets you have collected[/p][/*][*][p]Bug that sometimes set shop tickets to 80 in certain cases should be fixed[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: UPDATES FROM CORPORATE 8/12/25
notes.content: [p]GENERAL GAME CHANGES[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]A MAIN MENU NOW EXISTS, WILL BE A WORK IN PROGRESS FOR A BIT BUT THE MAIN FUNCTIONALITY IS THERE[/p][/*][*][p]THE FREELOOK CAMERA ON THE TAB KEY HAS BEEN IMPROVED, IT NO LONGER RESPECTS ANY OTHER POTENTIAL CAMERAS WHILE IN FREELOOK MODE[/p][/*][/list][p]CUSTOM GAME MODS[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]CUSTOM MODIFIER SETTINGS ADDED[/p][/*][*][p]THE INTENDED GAMEPLAY IS STILL BALANCED AROUND A NORMAL NO-MODIFIER PLAYTHROUGH[/p][/*][*][p]YOU CAN NOW MODIFY THE DIFFICULTY THROUGH THE FOLLOWING[/p][/*][*][p]ADD OR SUBTRACT FROM THE ENEMY SPAWN COUNTS[/p][/*][*][p]ADD OR SUBTRACT FROM THE ENEMY STARTING HEALTH POINTS[/p][/*][*][p]ADD A FLAT COST INCREASE OR DECREASE TO ALL CARDS ACROSS THE GAME[/p][/*][*][p]YOU CAN ALSO CHOOSE ANY SPECIFIC RANDOM ENCOUNTER ENEMIES AND ADD OR REMOVE THEM FROM THE SPAWN POOL TO CUSTOMIZE YOUR RUN[/p][/*][/list][p]RANDOM ENCOUNTERS[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]THE RANDOM ENCOUNTER SYSTEM HAS BEEN REBUILT, ENEMIES ARE NOW CHOSEN RANDOMLY FROM THE FULL LIST OF AVAILABLE ENEMIES[/p][/*][*][p]THE FIRST THREE FIGHTS ARE AN EXCEPTION. THEY HAVE A SLIGHTLY SMALLER POOL TO DRAW FROM, EXCLUDING SOME OF THE TOUGHER ENEMIES UNTIL AFTER THE FIRST BOSS[/p][/*][*][p]TWO NEW ENEMIES, THE BANKING MODULE AND THE SUPPRESSOR HAVE BEEN ADDED[/p][/*][/list][p]BUG FIXES[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]SELLING CARDS SHOULD NO LONGER DISALLOW ANY FUTURE COLLECTION OF THOSE CARDS[/p][/*][*][p]REWARD TEXT SOMETIMES OVERLAPPING SHOULD NO LONGER HAPPEN[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED SOME SAVE FILE CONFLICTION BUGS WITH NEW BUILDS, WHEN THE PLAYTEST HAS A BIG UPDATE WITH STRUCTURAL CHANGES THE BUILD MAY WIPE YOUR SAVE DATA, THIS IS STRICTLY FOR TESTING PURPOSES[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Additional Camera Option
notes.content:
[p]Just a tiny update fixing a few bugs and re-introducing the free look camera
[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]You can now press TAB in combat to swap between the fixed rotating camera and the freelook camera, controlled with WASD[/p][/*][*][p]New camera controllers for both the map and the shop allowing for some zooming in/out and smoother rotating[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Enemies should no longer attack empty space every once in a while[/p][/*][*][p]Some text UI elements should no longer get bugged out and stay on screen[/p][/*][*][p]Minor aesthetic adjustments to a few cards, nothing mechanical[/p][/*][*][p]Passwords have been removed for now[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Changes from Corporate 8/9/2025
notes.content: [p]Some card design adjustments and bug fixes, nothing too special here![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/p][list][*][p]New tooltips when hovering character cards in hand, showing their tribe type and damage type[/p][/*][*][p]Flavor text added to a bunch of enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Save system should now be protected from corrupting when migrating to new build. This one is a work in progress. If variables start tweaking out you should always be able to reset all save data in the settings menu to fix/zero out to default.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial should be less buggy[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies should no longer be able to spawn on top of each other[/p][/*][*][p]New mob [b]Office Grunt[/b], grants the player 300 budget when killed[/p][/*][*][p]Second boss enrage wasn't triggering, now it will attack up to 6 times below half hp[/p][/*][*][p]Death condition where your field hand and deck were empty should no longer bug out audio[/p][/*][*][p]Liquidation should always work now except for the first few turns of the tutorial[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]SPECIFIC CARD CHANGES[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ken Fieri[/b] changed to doomed grunt, spawns an intern on death[/p][/*][*][p][b]Consume[/b] changed to broad horizon, fill all open field slots with small aliens[/p][/*][*][p][b]Manipulator[/b] armor reduced from 15 to 12, Power reduced from 70 to 60[/p][/*][*][p][b]Twisted Husk[/b] changed to gain 20 power each time you play another alien[/p][/*][*][p][b]Factory Drone[/b] effect changed to shuffle an upgrade into your deck each time you play another robot, power reduced from 70 to 50[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cordell Keebler[/b] salary reduction changed from -200 to -100[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dave Divorcee[/b] cost reduced from 400 to 300[/p][/*][*][p][b]Consumer[/b] should no longer overheal[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dorry, Muscle Man[/b] damage on play increased from 30 to 60[/p][/*][*][p][b]Needletown Militia[/b] change to [b]Hitman[/b], On play: deal 100 stealth damage, and gain +150 salary. Cost changed from 800 to 1250[/p][/*][*][p][b]Franz, Artist[/b] has been changed to fill all open field slots with small cats on play[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deep Freeze[/b] damage increased from 30 to 60 ice damage for each character on the field[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrade[/b] changed to grant 20 power instead of 30[/p][/*][*][p][b]Void Grip[/b] cost reduced from 750 to 500 and now deals 100 Void damage to all available targets[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Central Chain City Banking Update - 8/7/2025
notes.content: [p][b]SAVINGS MECHANIC[/b][/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Savings is a new currency that allows progression to persists between runs[/p][/*][*][p]Collected cards, xp gained, and budget spent are converted into savings, granted at the end of your run during the new post-loss performance review[/p][/*][*][p]At the end of every run you will have a chance to spend savings to permanently collect a copy of any cards that were in your deck when the run ended[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]OTHER[/b][/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]The main combat camera for the players turn is now fixed with the ability to rotate the field and zoom with the mouse/mouse wheel[/p][/*][*][p]Handful of new enemies introduced to random encounter fights after the first boss[/p][/*][*][p]Playtesting cheats have been updated - codes in the discord[/p][/*][*][p]The new game button in settings has been split into clear all progress and end run[/p][/*][*][p]The collection system has been reworked a bit for better performance, duplicates will now stack[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of fights remaining is now displayed in the top-right of the combat UI[/p][/*][*][p]Various small visual/audio changes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]SPECIFIC CARD CHANGES[/b][/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Benson Grey has been changed to create a field slot on death[/p][/*][*][p]Consumer's healing has been reduced from a full heal to restoring 20 HP on attack[/p][/*][*][p]Gene Separation has been changed to cost 100, sacrifice any character to create a random alien in your hand[/p][/*][*][p]Meteor Queen has been buffed to now deal 30 damage to all of your characters instead of 50[/p][/*][*][p]Electricity Modifier buffed to deal 250 lightning damage for a cost of 200[/p][/*][*][p]Ambush changed to deal 130 stealth damage in total if used when the enemy is at full health[/p][/*][*][p]Execution Trap changed to draw a card, and then deal 120 damage if there are 5 or less cards in your deck[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Large Update from Corporate - 8/3/2025
notes.content:
[p]Fairly large update here~

CORE GAMEPLAY:[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Random encounters have been added[/p][/*][*][p]10 new enemies have been added-[/p][p](many are placeholder models without animations but the gameplay is there)[/p][/*][*][p]New enemy mechanics introduced like card destruction, corruption increase, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering over enemies now shows their name, power, and effects[/p][/*][*][p]Boss nodes appear on the map at levels 3 and 6[/p][/*][*][p]Leveling is simplified a bit, 1500 xp granted from random encounters and 3000 from bosses[/p][/*][*][p]The Corruption mechanic has been redesigned[/p][/*][*][p]In addition to bleeding resources at 100 corruption you now get one card from the top of your deck destroyed when you pass the turn with full corruption[/p][/*][*][p]Corruption rises by 10 every time you pass the turn (more than before)[/p][/*][*][p]Liquidation has been changed to REDUCE corruption by 5, in addition to the 100 budget gain[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]CARD ACQUISITION:[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Random encounter nodes grant +7 pack tickets[/p][/*][*][p]Boss encounters grant +15 pack tickets[/p][/*][*][p]Selling cards now grants one pack ticket[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]OTHER:[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Tons of individual card bug fixes - I'm sure some still exist[/p][/*][*][p]Parallax added to the cards for some better handling feel[/p][/*][*][p]UI has been updated heavily, lots of new tooltips[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial has been reworked quite a bit, it's still not perfect but it should at least get new players started quickly without too much info-dumping[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Fixes 7/26/25
notes.content: [p]Corporate has eradicated SOME bugs...[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]The games auto-saving has been improved and now saves more often[/p][/*][*][p]Screen transitions have been sped up dramatically[/p][/*][*][p]Camera boundaries and limitations have been improved, no more flipping upside-down or getting stuck in a corner[/p][/*][*][p]Camera bug related to attacking without any characters in play has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Settings menu re-organized[/p][/*][*][p]Deck out warning when your deck has zero cards remaining[/p][/*][*][p]New tooltip + sound + animation for when you are attempting to play a card without enough available budget[/p][/*][*][p]Profit has been reverted to XP for the time being, random gains has been turned off[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of text size reworks, animations have also been re-adjusted to help with clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial button disappearing under certain conditions has been debugged, tutorial should always appear on the main map[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer rotate the main map or select nodes while the settings menu is open[/p][/*][/list][p]CARD SPECIFIC FIXES[/p][list][*][p]The cost of Toy Robot has been adjusted[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update from Corporate - 07/20/2025
notes.content:
[p][b]Corporate has heard your complaints...
[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[b]UPDATE LOG:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New quick-start tutorial button has been added as an option[/p][/*][*][p]Character cards have new models with animations[/p][/*][*][p]Profit now increases over time, this is the experience/leveling system of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]On level up you gain +10 shop tickets[/p][/*][*][p]Some card illustrations have been changed[/p][/*][*][p]Text on all cards has been made larger and clearer[/p][/*][*][p]You can now hover over the bosses resistance icons to display damage type names[/p][/*][*][p]Damage numbers have been redesigned with a background for clarity[/p][/*][*][p]New arrow visuals to indicate viable card targets when a card is selected[/p][/*][*][p]A small line is now drawn from selected cards to the mouse[/p][/*][/list][p][b]BUG LOG:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Passwords had a case sensitivity bug that has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Boss attack hitboxes have been adjusted to not sometimes cleave unintentionally[/p][/*][*][p]Cards that target specific types are now unable to be played unless the target type is present[/p][/*][*][p]Volume sliders no longer disconnect on "new game" reload[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor UI changes, settings menu rearrangement, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Created cards should now always remain the correct size[/p][/*][/list][p][b]CARD-SPECIFIC FIXES:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Constable effect is now working[/p][/*][*][p]Shore goliath collider has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Factory drone collider has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Torch and other cards with type targeting have been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Ken Fieri now correctly creates Big Jim if there is room in hand[/p][/*][*][p]Tom, Chainsmoker properly shuffles smokes into your deck now[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Second Encounter - Now Available!
notes.content:
[p][b]Visionary. Disruptor. Bald by choice.[/b][/p][p]With over 27 years of experience in beverage-based mind control and consumer dependency engineering, [b]Malcolm Kessler[/b] specializes in leveraging thirst to drive loyalty, profit, and permanent physiological dependency.

"At Oblivion Beverages, we don’t sell drinks. We manufacture need. Under my leadership, we’ve achieved a 1300% growth in user addiction rates, crushed all major competitors, and introduced five new classified compounds into the civilian bloodstream"

-----[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]note* You must defeat the first boss to access the second![/b][/i]
[/p][p][b]UPDATE LOG:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Along with the second encounter, players can now access the first talent node, offering a one-time choice between a permanent buff: +100 salary, +500 budget, or +1 starting field slots.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New collection gallery view added in the shop.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Packs have been changed from 3 to 5 cards per pack.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Pack composition is now 1 rare, 1 uncommon, 1 uncommon or common, and 2 commons.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]You now start new games with 20 basic cards in your collection and one pack to open.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]The project has been updated to URP, lighting changes.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Self-Repair on the first boss has been lowered to trigger below 25% and only heal for 25%.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Incoming damage has been lowered on the first encounter.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Many small card balance changes[/b][/p][/*][/list]
